candidates.output: "You'll want to keep your hands in your pockets, friend. It's a cold morning for standing about." He checked the pistols without hurry. "Your man chose this. If you choose it too, there's a second box, and I've a second pair of gloves. But you've a family that expects you at breakfast. Think of the eggs going cold."
